user.title: Google Home authentication
user.description: For setup instructions, see {docs_url}. Enter your Google account username and an app password ({app_passwords_url}), or provide a master token. Creating an app password requires 2-Step Verification.

error.auth: Username or password is incorrect. If your Google account has 2-Step Verification enabled, generate an app password ({app_passwords_url}). If authentication still fails, see {troubleshooting_url}
error.pass-len: This integration supports passwords of up to {max_password_length} characters. Change your account password or use an app password ({app_passwords_url}).
error.missing-inputs: Please provide either username and password or master token
error.master-token-invalid: Master token invalid. Make sure that the full token has been specified (including 'aas_et/')

data.update_interval: Change the update interval. Increase this if your devices do not respond in time. Default: 180 (seconds)
